title: China National High School Math League
text:
The China National High School Math League is an annual mathematics competition for high school students in China, organized by the Chinese Mathematical Society. This event usually takes place on the first Sunday of September, with thousands of student nationwide participating. There are two sets of exams, A and B, for different provinces.

This competition consists of two parts. Part I consists of 8 fill-in-the-blank questions and 3 problems with a time limit of 80 minutes. Part II consists of 4 problems with a time limit of 170 minutes, allowing much more time for the significant increase in difficulty. The problems are usually proof-based.

The event plays a key role in selecting the provincial team for the Chinese Mathematical Olympiad. Students who excel at this competition will proceed to the provincial team, taking part in CMO afterwards.

China National High School Math League
Region: China
Type: Fill in the blanks & Proof
Difficulty: 2 - 6
Difficulty Breakdown:

Part I: 2-4
Part II: 4.5-6
